items.caption: Front hero — straight-on, eye-level, 5° forward tilt. Dark studio + electric-blue rim from camera-left + neon-magenta kicker from camera-right + light atmospheric haze. The reusable opener of any product spot.
3/4 low-angle heroic — camera 25° below the device, rotated 45° so front face + right side profile visible together. Specular highlights catch the casing edges. Sells weight + premium materials.
Extreme macro screen. Razor-focus on the OLED pixels + soft bokeh on the bezel. Cyan screen-glow + magenta rim. Tech-porn shot — drops in the middle of the spot for texture.
PCB macro — bare hardware tech-porn. Gold GPIO pins catch the rim lights. The 'we made this for builders' shot.
